# Copilot instructions

`CLAUDE.md` at the repository root holds the project rules for every agent and is binding. Read it in full first.

Then follow `docs/arc/delivery/external-agents.md`: what to read, the live-integration rules, the per-ticket workflow and the hand-back report. Work on one ticket at a time on its own `arc/<TICKET-ID>-<name>` branch. Do not push or merge.
